summary: Iteration 2 (Instagram-style rewrite) tested end-to-end. Backend: 38/38 pytest tests pass (18 iter1 regression + 20 new iter2 tests covering upload/file-serve, profile update, follow/unfollow, save/bookmark, comments, delete post, explore, search, stories, image-attached posts). Frontend: all critical flows verified — login, TopBar search (debounced) with user result → profile navigation, follow toggle updating followers_count 0→1, StoriesBar rendering neighbours (Rohan+Priya) with gradient rings, feed filter tabs, PostCard with like/save/comments/menu, comments sheet add+list, create post dialog (normal + offer + image upload+preview), bottom-nav navigation to Feed/Explore/Saved/Profile, EditProfile bio save, post deletion via menu on own post, image served via ?auth= query param, logout.

issues: The preview environment's fixed bottom-right 'Made with Emergent' badge overlaps the CreatePostDialog submit button AND the right-side items of BottomNav (nav-saved, nav-profile). On desktop everything is fine. This is a preview-platform artifact (badge will not exist in production), but worth knowing for manual mobile testing. Consider bumping BottomNav bottom padding / dialog footer padding so the submit button sits above a safe-area inset of ~72px on small screens.
On initial feed load for a brand-new user there is a brief flash of 'No neighbours yet' empty state before API resolves. Minor; consider skeleton placeholder.

action_items: (LOW) Add extra bottom padding / safe-area inset to CreatePostDialog footer and BottomNav so fixed preview badges don't overlap submit button on mobile (only affects preview environment).
(OPTIONAL) StoriesBar: render skeleton while /api/stories is loading instead of showing 'No neighbours' empty state.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~700 lines and mixes models, helpers, auth, and 10+ route groups in one file. Consider splitting into modules (routers/auth.py, routers/posts.py, routers/users.py, routers/upload.py) for maintainability.
/api/files/{path} reads the full object into memory then returns as Response — fine for 6MB limit but switch to StreamingResponse if limit grows.

serialize_user() does a count_documents() on every call including inside list endpoints (followers/following). For large follower counts this is O(N) per user fetched. Consider denormalising followers_count on the user doc and updating on follow toggle.
post_doc_to_out() also issues an extra find_one for author avatar on every post. For feeds of 200 posts that is 200 round-trips. Batch with $in or embed user_avatar_path in the post doc.
Search endpoint passes user-supplied q directly into a $regex without escaping — allows regex DoS (e.g. 'a.*a.*a.*...'). Escape with re.escape(q) before constructing the regex.

/api/files/{path} validates JWT but does NOT verify the file's owner_id against the token's user. Any authenticated user can fetch anyone's uploaded file by knowing the path. Acceptable for public social feed images, but worth an explicit decision.
FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated — migrate to lifespan context manager.
CORS allow_origins='*' with allow_credentials=True is spec-invalid. OK here because auth is header-based, but clean up for production.
EMERGENT_LLM_KEY used as bearer for object storage init — if init fails, upload returns 500 with generic 'Storage unavailable'. Log + surface a clearer error for diagnostics.
Bio max length (180) validated via Pydantic Field — good. But bio is Optional; a client could submit bio=null to clear. Currently handled correctly via `if payload.bio is not None`.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of critical flows verified on desktop; mobile blocked only by preview-env badge overlap (not a code bug)
